verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is an online IP-registration service portal, and such a portal could plausibly offer AI-generated insights (for example, AI-assisted similarity or prior-art analysis), so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents any AI-generated insights or suggestions from user data inside the product. The prior-art search (docs-3) is a search requested from INPI with no indication it is AI-generated, so it earns no credit here, and the llms.txt probe returned a 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
